__comment: The blocks the Engineer's Pick takes at Factorio's flat seconds-per-item instead of vanilla's hardness spread (ADR-0039). Terra's three ore fields and the stone they sit in, and nothing else: Factorio gives all four the same `mining_time`, and reproducing that spread-free shape is the point -- though the number itself is the pack's, half of Factorio's, after 2.0s failed ADR-0039's human-on-delivery check. Two deliberate omissions -- `#c:stones` would carry granite, andesite and diorite, which the ADR did not price, and cobblestone is SOFTER than stone, so the flat time would make the Pick slower on it than vanilla, which is the tedium the ADR rejects rather than the fidelity it asks for. Deepslate is here because it is the stone Terra's ore fields sit in below y0, not as a fourth stone type.
